svg.title: Stickman Rising: one fight plane, four worlds
svg.desc: An annotated concept atlas, not gameplay screenshots. Wet Bridge has a blue exterior with amber fixture returns. Night Station uses warm diffuse light on dry tile. Rain Market shows open rain and dry ground under one canopy. Red Quarry uses warm dry stone, dust in the distance and a pale daylight key. The same fighter pose and foot plane appear in every panel.
svg.text: A shape and color study for procedural sky, local exposure and anchored light.

text.tspan: Cool sky bearing behind a fixed skyline
Broken baked returns stay underneath road paint
Opaque arches establish depth; no exterior needed
Warm diffuse spill on matte, dry tile
Rain continues beyond both edges of one canopy
Sheltered paving stays dry under a steady practical
Pale daylight and haze separate the distant cuts
A short cast and matte stone, no wet treatment

svg.text: The place and weather can change. The fighter, footing and combat cues must stay readable.
